name: Microtone
$comment: GENERATED by tools/design-tokens.js from microtone-worker/css/microtone.css, microtone-touch-worker/css/touch.css and design-system/notes.json — never edit by hand.

themes.name: Dark
themes.note: Slate and amber, after taut.js. What :root declares, so a page without data-theme draws in it.

themes.name: Dim
themes.note: Neutral grey midway between dark and light; the theme the app boots into.

themes.name: Light
themes.note: Light grounds; every accent re-mixed darker (amber becomes burnt orange).

themes.name: Warmth
themes.note: The Analogue Warmth Edition: beige moulded plastic, with the texture tokens on top. Joins the theme cycle only while in season and is never saved.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background, the ground under every view; also the active tab's fill so it joins the view below it.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Bars and panels: top bar, status bar, pane heads, toolbox, command palette, modals and menus.

tokens.name: panel-2
tokens.usage: Raised controls on a panel: buttons, inputs, value controls, inactive tabs, the highlighted menu cell.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text and note glyphs, on bg, panel and panel-2. Clears 7:1 on every ground in every theme.

tokens.name: fg2
tokens.usage: Key-off glyphs in the grid; kept clearly brighter than dim so key-offs never read as empty cells.

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, captions, inactive tabs, empty grid cells, the step buttons of a value control. On bg and panel, at 0.82rem or larger; not on panel-2, where it misses 4.5:1 in most themes (see contrast).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Amber in the dark themes, burnt orange on light grounds: focus and hover borders, the active tab and tool, palette labels, sentinels and off-grid notes, and the Proceed button's fill (proceed-bg). Also the accent-color of every native checkbox, radio and slider. In warmth it is weak on bg; use it on panel or panel-2 there.

tokens.name: accent-2
tokens.usage: Cyan-blue: the instrument column, links, pan ticks and the selection-mode chip.

tokens.name: meter
tokens.usage: Green: VU bars, the volume column and live dots.

tokens.name: meter-bg
tokens.usage: Meter troughs and the idle ring of the loading spinner.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Every 1px hairline: control outlines, bar rules, pane seams, menu dividers. Below the 3:1 control-border floor in every theme as shipped, so a state is carried by the accent border, never by border alone.

tokens.name: ok-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the 'audio on' badge.

tokens.name: ok-fg
tokens.usage: Text of the 'audio on' badge, on ok-bg.

tokens.name: err-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the 'audio off' badge and of warnings.

tokens.name: err-fg
tokens.usage: Text of the 'audio off' badge and warnings, on err-bg; also the clip-lamp ink on the Mastering canvas.

tokens.name: rec-fg
tokens.usage: Record armed: the dot, the label and the hover border of the armed button. Weakest on rec-bg in dim; there it always rides with the record dot icon.

tokens.name: rec-border
tokens.usage: Record armed: the button's resting border.

tokens.name: rec-bg
tokens.usage: Record armed: the button's fill.

tokens.name: proceed-bg
tokens.usage: The Proceed button's fill: the one action a dialog is for (components/actions.js). The theme's accent, so 'the one that will happen' wears the hue that already means 'this one'.

tokens.name: proceed-fg
tokens.usage: The Proceed button's label, on proceed-bg; set at weight-proceed.

tokens.name: proceed-hover
tokens.usage: The Proceed button's fill under the pointer: a step further from proceed-fg than proceed-bg.

tokens.name: cv-bg
tokens.usage: Canvas ground for waveforms, envelopes and the splash grid.

tokens.name: cv-row-beat
tokens.usage: Pattern grid: the primary beat row band.

tokens.name: cv-row-bar
tokens.usage: Pattern grid: the secondary beat (bar) row band.

tokens.name: cv-playhead
tokens.usage: Pattern grid: the row that is playing.

tokens.name: cv-cursor
tokens.usage: Pattern grid: the cursor cell.

tokens.name: cv-caret
tokens.usage: Pattern grid: the sub-column caret in record mode (amber family).

tokens.name: cv-caret-nav
tokens.usage: Pattern grid: the sub-column caret in navigate mode (blue family).

tokens.name: cv-cue-line
tokens.usage: Pattern grid: the rule between cues.

tokens.name: cv-col-pan
tokens.usage: Pattern grid: pan column ink; also the effect ink in the splash grid.

tokens.name: cv-sel
tokens.usage: Pattern grid: block selection fill.

tokens.name: cv-ditto
tokens.usage: Pattern grid: ghost cells repeated by a pattern ditto.

tokens.name: cv-fx-op
tokens.usage: Effect column: the opcode letter (and an S/Z sub-command nibble).

tokens.name: cv-fx-a1
tokens.usage: Effect column: argument field 1.

tokens.name: cv-fx-a2
tokens.usage: Effect column: argument field 2.

tokens.name: cv-fx-a3
tokens.usage: Effect column: argument field 3.

tokens.name: cv-fx-ext
tokens.usage: Effect column: a ':' extension cell and the cell it pairs with.

tokens.name: cv-oct-red
tokens.usage: Register ramp stop 1 (the bottom of the keyboard). The ramp is ordered by hue only; it colours a 2px register stripe, never text.

tokens.name: cv-oct-yellow
tokens.usage: Register ramp stop 2 (low-middle).

tokens.name: cv-oct-green
tokens.usage: Register ramp stop 3 (high-middle).

tokens.name: cv-oct-blue
tokens.usage: Register ramp stop 4 (the top of the keyboard).

tokens.name: cv-pitch-pole
tokens.usage: Absolute-pitch plot: the rose ticks and the contour joining them, a hue nothing else in the cells wears.

tokens.name: cv-pitch-axis
tokens.usage: Absolute-pitch plot: the neutral centre rule behind the ticks.

tokens.name: cv-wave
tokens.usage: Waveform trace.

tokens.name: cv-wave-loop
tokens.usage: Waveform loop-region shading.

tokens.name: cv-wave-mid
tokens.usage: Waveform centre baseline.

tokens.name: cv-wave-invert
tokens.usage: Loop bytes the invert loop (S $F0xx) has inverted live.

tokens.name: cv-wave-funk
tokens.usage: Where funk repeat (Z $F0xx) has walked the loop to.

tokens.name: cv-play-cursor
tokens.usage: Envelope nodes and live envelope markers.

tokens.name: cv-wave-cursor
tokens.usage: Live play-position hairline over a waveform; hot pink so it never disappears into the trace or a modified byte.

tokens.name: cv-env-line
tokens.usage: Envelope polyline and zone strokes.

tokens.name: cv-env-node
tokens.usage: Envelope node dots.

tokens.name: cv-env-sus
tokens.usage: Envelope sustain-region shading.

tokens.name: cv-env-loop
tokens.usage: Envelope loop-region shading (translucent).

tokens.name: cv-live
tokens.usage: Live envelope cursor.

tokens.name: cv-pool-used
tokens.usage: Sample-memory panel: bytes a sample claims.

tokens.name: cv-pool-shared
tokens.usage: Sample-memory panel: bytes more than one census row claims.

tokens.name: cv-pool-free
tokens.usage: Sample-memory panel: unclaimed, swept space.

tokens.name: cv-pool-stale
tokens.usage: Sample-memory panel: unclaimed space still holding old audio.

tokens.name: cv-pool-region
tokens.usage: Pool map: a long recording loaded into memory.

tokens.name: cv-pool-c0
tokens.usage: Pool-map block cycle 1 of 5 (blue). Neighbouring blocks take consecutive entries, so the order matters more than the set.

tokens.name: cv-pool-c1
tokens.usage: Pool-map block cycle 2 of 5 (rose).

tokens.name: cv-pool-c2
tokens.usage: Pool-map block cycle 3 of 5 (cyan).

tokens.name: cv-pool-c3
tokens.usage: Pool-map block cycle 4 of 5 (violet).

tokens.name: cv-pool-c4
tokens.usage: Pool-map block cycle 5 of 5: separates by lightness, not hue (pale on dark grounds, near-black on light).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The wordmark's red half ('Micro') and the mark's ink.

tokens.name: brand2
tokens.usage: The wordmark's second half ('tone'), near-white on dark grounds and slate on light ones.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Motif editor: the page under the code (the Dimtello grey in the dark themes, the Syntello white in the light ones).

tokens.name: code-fg
tokens.usage: Motif editor: plain code text and the caret.

tokens.name: code-caret-row
tokens.usage: Motif editor: the band behind the caret's line.

tokens.name: code-sel
tokens.usage: Motif editor: the selection, drawn under the text (motifmarks.js).

tokens.name: code-occ-read
tokens.usage: Motif editor: other occurrences of the name under the caret, where it is read.

tokens.name: code-occ-write
tokens.usage: Motif editor: other occurrences of the name under the caret, where it is written.

tokens.name: code-gutter-bg
tokens.usage: Motif editor: the line-number gutter's ground.

tokens.name: code-gutter-fg
tokens.usage: Motif editor: line numbers.

tokens.name: code-gutter-here
tokens.usage: Motif editor: the caret line's number.

tokens.name: code-kw
tokens.usage: Motif editor: keywords (bold).

tokens.name: code-decl
tokens.usage: Motif editor: declaration keywords — song, instrument, lane, section (bold).

tokens.name: code-num
tokens.usage: Motif editor: numbers (bold).

tokens.name: code-str
tokens.usage: Motif editor: strings.

tokens.name: code-esc
tokens.usage: Motif editor: escapes inside a string.

tokens.name: code-pitch
tokens.usage: Motif editor: pitch literals (italic).

tokens.name: code-com
tokens.usage: Motif editor: comments (italic).

tokens.name: code-fn
tokens.usage: Motif editor: function calls; builtins in italic.

tokens.name: code-fn-decl
tokens.usage: Motif editor: a function's name where it is declared.

tokens.name: code-field
tokens.usage: Motif editor: record fields.

tokens.name: code-param
tokens.usage: Motif editor: parameters.

tokens.name: code-op
tokens.usage: Motif editor: operators.

tokens.name: code-name
tokens.usage: Motif editor: names given to music (italic).

tokens.name: code-err
tokens.usage: Motif editor: the line number of an error (bold).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The veil behind a modal, and behind the manual's contents drawer on a phone; one neutral black for every theme.

styles.name: wordmark-hero
styles.usage: The welcome screen hero (.wc-brand). Geist 900 oblique; Micro in brand, tone in brand2.

styles.name: wordmark-bar
styles.usage: The top-bar brand that opens About (.brand-container); 1.7rem inside the About modal.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Default button label at weight-button; 1.1rem for button.big. Open Sans at wdth 86.67 with tabular figures, as everywhere in the chrome.

styles.name: proceed
styles.usage: The Proceed button's label: weight-proceed, 200 heavier than every other button, on proceed-bg.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Projects live in your browser’s private storage.
styles.usage: Prose in modals (.modal-text p) and the welcome tagline.

styles.name: compact
styles.usage: Status bar, badges, toolbox and command-palette buttons, find bar fields; wdth 96.

styles.name: hint
styles.usage: Palette hints and secondary links, set in dim.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Palette and find-bar row labels, set in accent.

styles.name: menu-cell
styles.usage: Context-menu cell captions under a 30px icon.

styles.name: grid
styles.usage: The tracker grids (canvas pattern cells), the chord and notation makers, the keymap: Motif Grid, which draws every accidental, tick, slide mark and sentinel as a character.

styles.name: value
styles.usage: Typed hex and number values, indexes and inline readouts: Motif Mono.

styles.name: transport
styles.usage: The transport readouts in the top bar: Motif Transport, everything 10% narrower.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: The Motif editor and the manual's code: Motif Code, where i I l are narrower and M m W w wider, and bold and italic keep the roman's advances.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, badges, chips, find-bar fields, wheelable readouts.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, value controls, context-menu cells, the splash grid; tabs take it on their top corners only.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Modals, context menus, the meters canvas, drop zones.

tokens.name: weight-button
tokens.usage: Every button label.

tokens.name: weight-proceed
tokens.usage: The Proceed button's label. At least weight-button + 200: the rule is the difference, not the number.
